section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section reports that participants completed the 10-item Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2), the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (RSES), and the Satisfaction With Life Scale (SWLS). Demographics included sex, age, highest education, and self-reported weight and height (used to calculate BMI). The text refers to "the present study," indicating a single study; no sample size, country, survey method, or correlations between body appreciation and BMI are reported here.
